blocks.prompt: 7 (a) There are 8 men. Find the number of ways of arranging them in a row if: Two old men are at left side.
blocks.explanation:
8 alag aadmi ek line mein khare hone hain, lekin shart (condition) yeh hai ke do boorhe aadmi left side par hon, yani pehli do jagahon par.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: pehle shart wali jagahein bharein (do boorhe aadmi), phir baqi 6 aadmiyon ko baqi 6 jagahon par.
Rozmarra ki misaal: socho class ki photo ke liye 8 log line mein khare ho rahe hain aur ustad keh dete hain ke do buzurg sab se left par khare honge. Baqi log jahan marzi khare hon. Bas yahi sawal hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 aadmi; 2 boorhe aadmi left end ki do jagahon par.
Humein find karna hai: kitne tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Hamesha pehle woh hissa hal karein jis par shart hai, phir baqi azaad hissa. Aakhir mein fundamental principle of counting se multiply.
Kyun: Agar shart wali jagahein baad mein bharein to ho sakta hai pehle hi kisi aur ne woh jagah le li ho aur ginti ulajh jaye. Pehle pabandi, phir azaadi: yeh permutation ka sunehri usool hai.

Boorhe aadmiyon ko left par rakhein
\[\text{Tareeqe} = 2! = 2\]
Kyun: Pehli do jagahein sirf in do ke liye hain. Woh aapas mein jagah badal sakte hain: A pehle B doosra, ya B pehle A doosra, yani \(2!\) tareeqe.
Dhyan dein: Yeh \(2!\) bhoolna aam ghalti hai; log sirf \(6!\) likh dete hain.

Baqi 6 aadmiyon ko rakhein
\[\text{Tareeqe} = 6! = 720\]
Kyun: Baqi 6 jagahon par baqi 6 aadmi, un par koi shart nahi, to \(6!\).

Multiply karein
\[2! \times 6! = 2 \times 720 = 1440\]
Kyun: Boorhon ki har tarteeb baqi logon ki har tarteeb ke saath ban sakti hai, is liye multiply.
Dhyan dein: Yahan jama (add) nahi karna. "Aur" (pehle yeh, phir woh) wale kaam mein multiply hota hai; "ya" (yeh ya woh) wale cases mein add.

Tasdeeq
Box method: jagah 1 aur 2 par 2 aur 1 choices; jagah 3 se 8 par 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
\[2 \cdot 1 \cdot 720 = 1440 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har jagah alag alag gin kar bhi wohi jawab aaya.
blocks.final_answer:
1440 tareeqe
Yaani do buzurg left par aur baqi 6 kahin bhi: kul 1440 tareeqe.

blocks.prompt: 7 (b) There are 8 men. Find the number of ways of arranging them in a row if: The youngest man is not at the right side.
blocks.explanation:
Yahan shart ulti hai: sab se chhota (youngest) aadmi right end par NAHI hona chahiye.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: "nahi" wale sawal ka sab se aasaan tareeqa: kul arrangements mein se woh arrangements nikaal do jin mein youngest right end par hai.
Do raste hain: seedha ginna (pehle right wali jagah bharna) ya ulta ginna (kul mein se na-pasandeeda nikaalna). Hum dono karenge taake jawab pakka ho jaye.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 aadmi; youngest sab se right wali jagah par na ho.
Humein find karna hai: kitne tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Matloob tareeqe = kul tareeqe \(-\) woh tareeqe jin mein youngest right end par hai.
Kyun: "Nahi" wali shart ko seedha ginna kabhi kabhi mushkil hota hai, jabke "hai" wali shart ginna aasaan. Is liye ulta raasta (complement) le kar minus karte hain.

Kul arrangements
\[8! = 40320\]
Kyun: 8 alag aadmi 8 jagahon par, koi shart nahi.

Youngest right end par ho
\[7! = 5040\]
Kyun: Youngest ko right end par fix kar diya (sirf 1 tareeqa), baqi 7 aadmi baqi 7 jagahon par \(7!\) tareeqon se.
Dhyan dein: Youngest ko fix karne ke baad baqi 7 log 7 jagahon par hain, 8 par nahi; \(8!\) likhna ghalat hoga.

Minus karein
\[8! - 7! = 40320 - 5040 = 35280\]
Kyun: Na-pasandeeda arrangements nikaal di to sirf woh bachi jin mein youngest right end par nahi.
Ek aur nazar: \(8! - 7! = 7!(8 - 1) = 7 \times 7!\). Yeh bilkul wohi hai jo seedhe tareeqe se aata hai.

Tasdeeq (seedha tareeqa)
Right wali jagah par youngest ke ilawa koi bhi 7 mein se (7 tareeqe), baqi 7 jagahon par baqi 7 log: \(7!\).
\[7 \times 7! = 7 \times 5040 = 35280 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Shart wali jagah pehle bharne se bhi wohi jawab aaya. Do raston se ek jawab, matlab bharosa.
